## Rule

Four color-4 cells are the corners of a rectangular frame. Let the frame bbox be
`rows r0..r1, cols c0..c1`; the output is this frame normalized to the top-left, with
shape `(r1-r0+1) x (c1-c0+1)`.

The frame's left and right vertical border cells give the two guide colors:
`L = input[r0+1][c0]`, `R = input[r0+1][c1]`. The off-frame template is the bounding box
of all cells of colors `L` or `R` outside the frame rectangle. If the off-frame `L` cells
start to the right of the off-frame `R` cells, horizontally mirror the whole template;
otherwise keep it as-is.

Output assembly: put color-4 at the four corners, fill the left/right interior border
columns with `L`/`R`, and copy the possibly mirrored off-frame template into the frame
interior starting at output cell `(1,1)`. Interior zeros remain background. Padding outside
the variable output uses sentinel color 10 before the final `Equal(..., 0..9)` expansion so
it decodes as all-zero one-hot padding, not channel-0 background.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
def solve(grid):
    corners = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 4]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in corners), max(r for r, _ in corners)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in corners), max(c for _, c in corners)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    L, R = grid[r0 + 1][c0], grid[r0 + 1][c1]

    cells = [
        (r, c, v)
        for r, row in enumerate(grid)
        for c, v in enumerate(row)
        if v in (L, R) and not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1)
    ]
    tr0, tc0 = min(r for r, _, _ in cells), min(c for _, c, _ in cells)
    tc1 = max(c for _, c, _ in cells)
    flip = min(c for _, c, v in cells if v == R) < min(c for _, c, v in cells if v == L)

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    out[0][0] = out[0][-1] = out[-1][0] = out[-1][-1] = 4
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        out[r][0], out[r][-1] = L, R
    for r, c, v in cells:
        rr = 1 + r - tr0
        cc0 = c - tc0
        cc = 1 + ((tc1 - tc0) - cc0 if flip else cc0)
        out[rr][cc] = v
    return out
```
